baits_26.note: Match. IntAct collapses Nsp1-16 into the pp1ab polyprotein (P0DTD1) by default; recovered per-Nsp identity via UniProt PRO_ chain feature ids to reconstruct all 26 named baits.

druggable_66.note: Confirmed from the paper full text (abstract): '66 druggable human proteins or host factors targeted by 69 compounds (of which 29 drugs are approved [FDA])'. This is a curated druggability annotation from Gordon Table, separate from the 332 PPI interaction record.

drugs_69.note: Confirmed from paper: 69 compounds targeting the 66 proteins; 29 are FDA-approved drugs.

worked_example_validity: Orf6 binds BOTH NUP98 and RAE1 in ground truth; holding out Orf6-RAE1 while keeping Orf6-NUP98 and adding the NUP98-RAE1 human complex edge (STRING) gives a valid L3 recovery path.
